title: Interactive Math Teaching Tools
description:
40+ real-time, browser-based interactive applications for teaching and learning Differential Equations, Linear Algebra, and Numerical Methods. Tools include phase portraits with trajectories, linear-algebra calculators, mass-spring-damping simulators, polynomial interpolation, finite-difference schemes, and many more.

Source code (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Python) is released under the MIT License. The educational content (text, equations, figures, explanations) is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Live site: https://shelvean.github.io/math-tools/
